issues.title: Freeze/durability gate verifies hash-reachability, NOT parameter executability
issues.evidence: V2 froze seed '20260904b'; reachable from origin/main, sha 84d7f198, READY_TO_EXECUTE=YES, but SplitMix64('20260904b') -> TypeError. v2_result.json.
issues.fix: Add a dry-run/validate step to the freeze primitive: every frozen executable parameter must parse/typecheck before READY_TO_EXECUTE=YES.

issues.title: create_world has no idempotency key; blind retry doubles worlds
issues.evidence: B1: same config thrice -> 3 world_ids. H2. K1 shows 189 worlds already accumulated.
issues.fix: Accept Idempotency-Key on POST /v2/worlds (as artifacts/experiments already do).

issues.title: Observation without work_id is silently CLIENT_ASSERTED; nothing forces attestation
issues.evidence: C3: observation, no work_id -> observations_engine_attested=0. Both classes accepted; only a status read reveals which.
issues.fix: Adapter must ALWAYS bind work_id; optionally a world flag requiring ENGINE_WORK_RESULT for a namespace.

issues.title: PEW anchor causal-correctness is unenforced (shape+existence only)
issues.evidence: D1: anchoring on WORLD_CREATED would pass PEW's shape + (event_id,entry_hash) checks. PEW cannot know the event is the run's observation.
issues.fix: Adapter selects the anchor by strict refs.exp_id==exp_id single-match (already the rule in readback); make it a shared primitive so no agent hand-picks.

issues.title: Organism integrity is a client-only assertion; SFE accepts arbitrary bytes
issues.evidence: A3: corrupt bytes accepted by SFE (content-addressed); only blob_hash==sha256:organism_id catches it. An adapter skipping the gate fossilizes corruption with a valid-looking blob_hash.
issues.fix: The identity gate must live in the shared arena primitive, not be re-implemented per probe. P0 IF ever skipped.

issues.title: Fossil cannot carry action/input/output-digest/full-world-config/registry-id/schema-versions
issues.evidence: completeness_analysis.json: 9 of 16 identities MISSING or AMBIGUOUS. B5: get_world omits budget.
issues.fix: Add typed fossil fields (action, input_digest, output_digest, world_config, registry_id, producer_versions, schema_versions) OR a durable side-artifact the fossil references by hash.

issues.title: Replay requires the repo checkout that produced the run; fossil alone is insufficient
issues.evidence: completeness_analysis.json replay: input+seed+action live in the frozen directive/integration_record.json, not the fossil.
issues.fix: Once I-FOSSIL-INCOMPLETE lands, a replay primitive can reconstruct inputs from the fossil alone.

issues.title: The 14-step manual path with hand-copied identities should be one primitive
issues.evidence: run_integration.py: 13 client calls + pew_write.py: 6 PEW calls; organism_id/world_id/exp_id/work_id/event_id/entry_hash copied by hand between systems (transcription risk).
issues.fix: arena.run(organism, world_config, action_plan) -> {fossil, evidence_id, readback}; must guarantee the identity gate, work_id attestation, strict anchor selection, full fossil, and auto read-back. SPEC ONLY this pass.

issues.title: GET .../events return shape inconsistent: dict {'events':[...]} vs bare list
issues.evidence: K4: first integration got dict; this pass got a list, breaking the harness mid-run until patched.
issues.fix: Pin one shape in the API (or normalize in sfclient).

issues.title: GET /v2/worlds returns all 189 worlds unscoped; an agent can't tell which are its own
issues.evidence: K1: n=189. No session/agent/owner filter observed.
issues.fix: Add ?session_id=/?owner= filter + a state filter to /v2/worlds.

issues.title: TERMINATED does not end artifact-write lifetime; semantics undocumented
issues.evidence: B4: artifact write AFTER terminate succeeded.
issues.fix: Document (or enforce) what TERMINATED forbids; agents must not infer lifetime from it (addendum note 4).

issues.title: Source packets not independently readable over HTTP
issues.fix: Add GET /packets/{id} so evidence provenance is fully HTTP-traversable.

issues.title: Probe/test worlds accumulate with no GC (189 and counting)
issues.evidence: K1 n=189 after repeated integration + probe passes.
issues.fix: A test-namespace world reaper, or a TTL on ISOLATED worlds with no recent events.
